title: CANcestry UDS server configuration (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for the CANcestry UDS server configuration file (Phase 10, issue #26). Declares the diagnostic data identifier (DID) table and the routine table the UDS server (core/uds) serves for ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22), WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E) and RoutineControl (0x31). A document that fails this schema is refused at load time (fail-closed, schema is law). Byte arrays use block YAML sequences of integers 0..255; the C loader enforces the same YAML subset as the codec, recipe and FSM loaders.

did.description: Data identifier (two bytes on the wire). Unique within the document.

length.description: Fixed data length of the DID in bytes. A signal-mapped DID is additionally restricted to 1..8 bytes by the loader (little-endian mirror into a 64-bit signal value).

read_only.description: Advisory policy flag carried into every governor WRITE_DID request; the reference governor denies writes to read-only DIDs (SW-FR-UDS-007).

signal.description: Optional codec signal name (short or <codec_map>.<signal> canonical form). ReadDataByIdentifier encodes the current shared signal value little-endian; an approved WriteDataByIdentifier mirrors the written bytes into the signal (SW-FR-UDS-008).

default.description: Initial DID data bytes seeded into the DID data store at server initialization. When present the loader requires exactly `length` bytes.

routine.description: Routine identifier (two bytes on the wire). Unique within the document.

allowed.description: Whether this sub-function is accepted for the routine; a disallowed operation returns NRC 0x12.

response.description: Static response record bytes appended to the positive response (SW-FR-UDS-004). Routines with dynamic behaviour are a later phase.
